findings.suggestion: Mutate the resolved clone instead of constructing a new one, e.g. `source_expressions = result.get_source_expressions(); source_expressions[0] = expr.get_cols()[0]; result.set_source_expressions(source_expressions); return result`.

findings_dropped.finding: The composite-PK uniqueness check uses equality, but the neighbouring `unique_together` and `UniqueConstraint` checks use subset (`<=`). A `ForeignObject` whose `to_fields` include all PK fields plus extra columns is still unique, yet it would be reported as fields.E310.
findings_dropped.suggestion: Use `frozenset(field.name for field in remote_opts.pk_fields) <= foreign_fields` to match the other uniqueness checks.
